Procedure title: Online learning expertise and scientific advisory (UCC-VEAT-2024-02)
Description: This is a voluntary ex-ante transparency (VEAT) notice. This notice acknowledges that University College Cork contracted with Randbee Consultants SRL, for the provision of support and leadership of online learning resource maintenance, development and enhancement for the Copernicus Atmospheric Monitoring Service and Copernicus Climate Change Service under the competitively won ECMWF Service Contract CJS2_156b_UCC. Under CJS2_156b_UCC, UCC is leading a Service team to provide support to the ECMWF in implementing training events and online learning resources for the two Copernicus Services. Randbee Consultants SL will lead the online learning resource activities for the overall Service contract, provide technical support to implement resource solutions, contribute niche expertise to the Scientific Advisory Committee, and support Training event implementation and online content maintenance services. Randbee Consultants SRL were uniquely placed in terms of skillsets, professional networks and relationships to perform their role in this overall service contract, further enhanced by their good standing, and track record of excellence. They have an extensive track record of working with European and International projects, providing valuable services and training on Copernicus product applications, Earth Observation, Geographical Information Systems (GIS), statistical analysis, modelling, and web visualization tools. The company's experience with both in-person and remote training formats aligns strongly with the diverse delivery methods outlined in the overarching Service Contract.
